notes.title: Patch v 1.35
notes.content:
Full list of changes

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Heavy and light attacks are getting separate buttons. This change will enable faster shooting and more fluid gameplay. 
[*] Controls are getting rehashed, so now there are more convenient control setups for the keyboard and controller.
[*] Stamina balancing - some activities were draining too much stamina at the start level, so new changes address this problem.
[/list]
[b]AI[/b]
[list]
[*] Plants sometimes pause mid-attack, breaking their attack loop. This patch fixes this problem. 
[/list]
[b]Level Design & Effects[/b]
[list]
[*] The bug where some of the traps were not colliding with the player - fixed. 
[*] New sound effects for various levels and actions are now present.
[*] All types of Lizards get new designs - color and normal maps.
[*] All plants had the wrong color lips when spitting - fixed.
[*] Some particles during fireball creation were not showing - fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Release 1.3.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39224674/fbf634b3179485a75a15149050264fa0e42dac8d.png[/img]

[b]Changes[/b]

Optimization
[list]
[*] Texture resolution lowered on some backgrounds
[*] Better particle implementation
[*] Light optimization
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39224674/61126acbc647728b6657ef748c5c8240e3b0fd8b.png[/img]

Graphics
[list]
[*] Added new lights on crucial places
[*] Added lights fx on explosions
[*] New and fresh sprites

[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39224674/0be8be932287ff8c362977951adbfb756eaacf15.png[/img]

Gameplay

notes.title: Update Notice - 2 Jan
notes.content:
There will be an update on 2 January to fix a few bugs and make some improvements. That will be the first post-release update.

Here are the contents of this update:
-Tweaked Physics. The player has more time to maneuver while in the air
-Camera follows the character more tightly
-Platforms are more reachable

I wish you all the best in the New 2021 !!!
